Name: Owljoy Shop Search
Author: OwlandJoy
Description:
[b][color=#ea9999][size=5]Features[/size][/color][/b]
------------------------------
✿ Search any standard shop menu.
✿ Live filtering as you type.
✿ Displays the number of visible results.
✿ Full keyboard and mouse support.
✿ Works with vanilla and most modded shops that use Stardew Valley's standard ShopMenu.

[b][color=#ea9999][size=5]Requirements[/size][/color][/b]
------------------------------
✿ SMAPI
✿ Stardew Valley 1.6+

[color=#ea9999][size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size][/color]
------------------------------
✿ The search resets each time you open a shop.
✿ Compatible with vanilla shops and most mods that use the standard shop interface.

[color=#f9cb9c][size=5][b]Support the Mod ✩°𓏲⋆🌿. ⋆[/b][/size][/color]
------------------------------
